verdict.recommendation: DISCARD variant. DD 7/22 calibration on IndMom+QualGate is ineffective: MDD only reduced marginally while destroying returns (CAGR 4.57% vs BM 9.03%). The underlying pure factor (S2 base) already showed weak alpha; the DD overlay cannot rescue a fundamentally weak signal. Consider: (1) IndMom may require sector-neutral scoring rather than quality gate, (2) DD 7/22 parameters too aggressive for a low-vol strategy — floor at 30% exposure drains returns in prolonged drawdowns.

role_honesty_audit.evidence: BM_Corr=0.619 too high for diversifier. Negative alpha in FF3/FF5. Underperforms BM in 2/4 stress periods. S4 delta_sharpe=-0.103 (detracts from portfolio). A diversifier needs either low correlation (<0.3) or consistent positive crisis alpha; this variant has neither.
